chapter: Art Hodes, Bechet and Blue Note
title: Between the Victoria and Hodes: the Nest with Dave Nelson
summary: In the gap years he worked at the Nest with Dave Nelson.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, 1945. April 6, 1945. But before we get to these recordings and this period with Art Hodes, I just want to try to fill in those years. You say from the
Victoria Cafe up until the time you went with Art Hodes... Were you staying at the Victoria Cafe, playing there? Or were you playing with various other musicians?
No, I went out for a while. I didn't play no place for a while.
In my spare time, I went to work with Dave Nelson at this after-hour place on 133rd Street. Called it the Nest.
During that time I was working at night, and rehearsing sometimes in the daytime. That's when I come to meet Dave Nelson.
